title: Suvarna Vidhana Soudha, Belagavi
author: Aman.kumar.karn
description: The monumental administrative and legislative secretariat in Belagavi, inaugurated in 2012, symbolizing North Karnataka's political and economic empowerment.

title: Rani Chennamma Circle, Belagavi City
author: Djsonu007
description: Vibrant civic tri-junction featuring the iconic equestrian bronze monument of Kittur Rani Chennamma.

title: Gokak Falls (Ghataprabha River)
author: Shishirmk
description: Formed by the Ghataprabha River plunging 52 meters, site of India's earliest hydro-electric generating stations (1887).

title: Kittur Rani Chennamma Fort & Citadel
author: Pixabay / Wikimedia Commons Contributor
license: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication
description: Citadel of Rani Chennamma, who led the armed resistance against the British East India Company in 1824.

title: Belagavi Airport (Sambra IXG)
author: Wikimedia Commons Contributor
description: North Karnataka's premier operational commercial airport with 2,300m runway connecting Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi, and Hyderabad.

title: Fort of Belgaum Historic Bastions
author: Col. James Welsh Collection
description: 13th-century stone fortification constructed by Jaya Raya of the Ratta dynasty, featuring deep water moats and interfaith shrines.

title: Kamala Basti (Kamal Basadi), Belagavi Fort
author: Mallikarjun H. Sarvi
description: Historic 10th-century Chalukyan-style Jain monument inside Belagavi Fort, renowned for its 72-petal inverted stone lotus ceiling.

title: VTU Jnana Sangama Campus Headquarters
author: Souravmohanty2005
description: Headquarters of Visvesvaraya Technological University directing engineering curricula across 200+ colleges statewide.

title: Raja Lakhamagouda Reservoir (Hidkal Dam)
author: Gurukant
description: Major dam across Ghataprabha River in Hukkeri taluk, nurturing regional agriculture and sugar industrial belts.

title: Belagavi City Landscape from Rajhansgad
author: Arch.ravikiran
license: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication
description: Expansive panoramic vista of Belagavi city and surrounding Western Ghat foothills.
